strengths: Questions explicitly connect results to methods, comparisons, mechanisms, figures, or boundaries.
Every retained question, link, and research-thread provenance bundle is exactly grounded in supplied paper text.
The dominant question functions are mechanism explanation, evidence testing, comparison, and boundary finding, which are relevant to hypothesis generation.
limitations: Figure support currently uses captions and textual figure references; image pixels and plotted values are not interpreted.
Research-thread prose is model synthesis over grounded context; provenance validates source availability but not field-level entailment.
Similarity retrieval can miss relevant passages that use unrelated terminology or implicit sample references.
Questions still require materials-expert ranking for novelty and practical experimental value.
